_note: Plain-English notes shown in the online app's 'Update ready' card. Newest first. Add an entry with every release.

notes: A new look for the app icon. Same bowl, same smile, slightly more tired.
Gentler wording for the vegetarian rule in Settings.
Small admin improvement.
Small behind-the-scenes improvements to how reports reach us.
Small behind-the-scenes update to the 💬 report button.
During testing: tap the 💬 in the bottom corner on any page to report a problem.
New: Settings → Report a problem. Tell us what went wrong and it's sent with your app version and device type.
Spices and cupboard items you tick off are set back to "Got it" in the spice rack when you press Done shopping.
Fixed: spices and cupboard items marked Low or Out now appear on the shopping list.
The spice rack's button now adds anything this week's dinners need that you haven't checked yet.
Nights marked "out" now always stay with the right person, even if someone else is removed from the household.
Cooking mode: when a step says "the rest of" something, it no longer shows half the amount unless you really did use half earlier.
Who's eating has moved up next to the lock on each day.
Quieter week: days where everyone is eating just show the people icon. Tap it to change who's eating.
Tidied Settings: removed a placeholder row for a feature that isn't ready yet.
The shopping list no longer rounds down eggs, wraps and buns for bigger households.
Weekly staples now live on the shopping list only, including before you've planned any dinners.
Less small print: helper text throughout is shorter or gone where it wasn't needed.
Weekly staples have their own card on the shopping list.
'Add item' sits next to 'Done shopping', and the buttons no longer cover the bottom of the list.
The 'Cooking for little ones' switch is back, in Who you cook for. Switching it off keeps their details for later.
Tidier lists: names line up, with the details underneath.
Settings has one 'Who you cook for' list: grown-ups and little ones together, with simple sizes (Smaller, Regular, Larger, Extra) and what they mean in calories.
Each night in the week shows who's eating: tap it to switch people in or out, or add guests.
Leftovers are in one 'Left over this week' card on the shopping list, with ideas to use them up.
A little one's share no longer buys a whole extra tin or pack.
Cook double leaves a night off as a night off.
Opening a day's recipe from the week shows that day's amounts, guests and all.
'Half the oil' in cooking mode now shows half.
Weekly staples are now in the shopping list's ⋯ menu (and still reachable from Settings).
After a shuffle, an Undo button stays next to Shuffle until you change something else that week.
The planner now picks dinners that use up each other's part-packs: about 30% less left over each week.
Tap a shopping item with some left over to see recipes that use the rest, and put one on a day.
If something important isn't set, like allergies or a child's birth date, the Settings button glows until it is.
Guests, or someone out? Tap ⋯ on a day, then 'Who's eating', and the shopping list and amounts follow.
Cook double: twice the amounts tonight, and tomorrow becomes leftovers.
The shopping list notes when a pack will be left over (e.g. '¾ tin left over') for things that go off.
Set your own aisle order in Settings.
Each recipe now says how to store, freeze and reheat leftovers safely.
Fixed: closing Swap returns to the recipe, and the under-6-months note uses the baby's actual age.
Cooking mode shows the ingredients and amounts each step uses, so there's no scrolling back with messy hands.
Set your usual dinner time in Settings and the Today card says when to start.
Changed your mind after 'Shuffle'? There's now an Undo.
The planner avoids repeats from the last 3 weeks and suggests meals you loved more often.
New households are asked about allergies on first use.
Budget mode no longer swaps in something your household avoids (e.g. bottled lemon juice if you avoid sulphites).
Small recipe fixes for little ones' portions, and more security tightening.
Safety review: baby portions now use full-fat yoghurt, squashed edamame and soft (not crispy) chickpeas, beansprouts are always cooked through, and eggs for little ones are always fully set.
A warning shows when shop-bought foods make a little one's portion salty, and for babies under 6 months.
Fixed five recipes that were missing a step when you're not cooking for little ones.
Security improvements.
Updates now wait for you: a blue ! on Settings means a new version is ready, with what's new.
The app checks for new versions whenever you switch back to it.
Done shopping moves ticked items into 'Bought this week', so the list shows only what's left and what it'll cost.
Once tonight's dinner is cooked, the Today card asks how it was.
Calories now show on the Today card, week and recipes. Tap a name for protein and the full breakdown.
Every recipe's method has been rewritten step by step, starting with the chopping and prep.
